name: game-battle-log
description: Tool rows as an 8-bit battle log: a TURN header on each turn's first row, HIT, CRIT with +added −removed lines, MISS with the lines that say what failed, COMBO ×n and BREAK, each guard's own verdict (TRAP!, BARRIER!, LOOP!), and SUMMON on the run-in-background pill

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off leaves tool rows to the engine; casual draws short verdicts (HIT, MISS); hardcore draws game phrasing (CLAUDE의 BASH! … MISS…)

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals; theme follows your Claude Code theme (use it on a light background)
